license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person who does not hold an active, unexpired license issued pursuant to this article, or who is not practicing pursuant to the licensure exceptions set forth in this section, to: (1) Engage in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state

issuing_authority.quote: The board is autonomous and, in accordance with this article, shall determine qualifications of applicants for licenses to practice medicine and surgery, to practice podiatry, and to practice as a physician assistant for a physician licensed under this article, and shall issue licenses to qualified applicants

name.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Board of Medicine established in section five of this article.

type.quote: The board is autonomous and, in accordance with this article, shall determine qualifications of applicants for licenses to practice medicine and surgery

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or equivalent from an approved school of medicine
degree_required.quote: graduated and received the degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent from a school of medicine located within the United States, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or Canada, and is approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or by the board

accrediting_body.quote: approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or by the board

degree_level.quote: graduated and received the degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent from a school of medicine

school_approval_basis.quote: approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or by the board

credential_pegged.quote: graduated and received the degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent from a school of medicine located within the United States, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or Canada, and is approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or by the board

required.quote: Has successfully completed: (i) A minimum of one year of graduate clinical training in a program is approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

experience_source.quote: Has successfully completed: (i) A minimum of one year of graduate clinical training in a program is approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

duration.value: minimum of one year (domestic graduates); minimum of two years for foreign medical graduates
duration.quote: A minimum of one year of graduate clinical training in a program is approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

kind.quote: A minimum of one year of graduate clinical training in a program is approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Must pass all component parts within 10 consecutive years
exams.quote: Has, within 10 consecutive years, passed all component parts of the United States Medical Licensing Examination or any prior examination or examination series approved by the board which relates to a national standard, is administered in the English language, and is designed to ascertain an applicants fitness to practice medicine and surgery

interval_years.quote: A license to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state is valid for a term of two years.

required.quote: A certification of participation in and successful completion of a minimum of fifty hours of continuing medical or podiatric education satisfactory to the board, as appropriate to the particular license, during the preceding two-year period.

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of fifty hours of continuing medical or podiatric education satisfactory to the board

period_years.quote: a minimum of fifty hours of continuing medical or podiatric education satisfactory to the board, as appropriate to the particular license, during the preceding two-year period

value: best-practice prescribing of controlled substances training
training on prescribing and administering an opioid antagonist (if prescribing controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: shall complete drug diversion training, best-practice prescribing of controlled substances training, and training on prescribing and administering an opioid antagonist if that person prescribes, administers, or dispenses a controlled substance
topical_requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 1. General Provisions Applicable to All State Boards

available.quote: Any person seeking to be licensed to practice medicine and surgery in this state who holds a valid license to practice medicine and surgery attained under requirements similar to the requirement of 30-3-10 of this code from another state, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or Canada... shall be issued a license

requirements.value: Must hold a valid license from another state/DC/Puerto Rico/Canada under similar requirements, submit application with fee, demonstrate requisite qualifications to provide the same standard of care as a physician initially licensed in WV, and be in good standing with no undisclosed disciplinary history.
requirements.quote: He or she must demonstrate to the satisfaction of the board that he or she has the requisite qualifications to provide the same standard of care as a physician or podiatrist initially licensed in this state.

exists.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Board of Medicine established in section five of this article.

national_certification.value: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG)
national_certification.quote: Holds a valid ECFMG certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

national_association.quote: the applicant holds a current certification by a member board of the American Board of Medical Specialties

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person who does not hold an active, unexpired license issued pursuant to this article, or who is not practicing pursuant to the licensure exceptions set forth in this section, to: (1) Engage in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state

credential_type.quote: shall determine qualifications of applicants for licenses to practice medicine and surgery... and shall issue licenses to qualified applicants

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person who does not hold an active, unexpired license issued pursuant to this article, or who is not practicing pursuant to the licensure exceptions set forth in this section, to: (1) Engage in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state

title_protection.quote: Represent that he or she is a physician, surgeon or podiatrist authorized to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state; or (3) Use any title, word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that he or she is licensed to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person who does not hold an active, unexpired license issued pursuant to this article, or who is not practicing pursuant to the licensure exceptions set forth in this section, to: (1) Engage in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or renew a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or known board error
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, renewing, or attempting to renew a license or other authorization to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through known error of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found guilty of a felony, crime of moral turpitude, or crime directly relating to practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found guilty of a crime in any jurisdiction, which offense is a felony, involves moral turpitude, or directly relates to the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unauthorized person to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unauthorized person to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry contrary to law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report, failing to file required reports, or obstructing required filings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report that the person knows to be false; intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law; willfully impeding or obstructing the filing of a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requesting, receiving, or paying kickbacks or referral fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Requesting, receiving, or paying directly or indirectly a payment, rebate, refund, commission, credit, or other form of profit or valuable consideration for the referral of patients to any person or entity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Referring patients to a lab or pharmacy in which the physician has an undisclosed proprietary interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct by any physician or podiatrist in referring a patient to any clinical laboratory or pharmacy in which the physician or podiatrist has a proprietary interest unless the physician or podiatrist discloses in writing such interest to the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for sexual activity or engaging in sexual misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for the purpose of engaging a patient in sexual activity or engaging in other sexual misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representation in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients through fraud, intimidation, or undue influence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients, either personally or by an agent, through the use of fraud, intimidation, or undue influence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written records justifying the course of treatment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written records justifying the course of treatment of a patient, including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination and test results, and treatment rendered, if any

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on a patient to exploit the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on a patient in such a way as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician or podiatrist or of a third party.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances other than in good faith and in a therapeutic manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a prescription drug, including any controlled substance under state or federal law, other than in good-faith and in a therapeutic manner in accordance with accepted medical standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing experimental procedures on human subjects without full informed written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy that, by the accepted standards of medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing responsibilities the physician is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities that the person knows or has reason to know he or she is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the physician or podiatrist delegating the responsibilities knows or has reason to know that the person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the article or a rule or order of the board, or failing to comply with a subpoena
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this article or a rule or order of the board or failing to comply with a subpoena or subpoena duces tecum issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another physician from lawfully advertising services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with any other person to commit an act or committing an act that would tend to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another physician or podiatrist from lawfully advertising his or her services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the use and control of prescription forms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the use and control of prescription forms

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental impairment, including drug or alcohol abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The inability to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental impairment, including deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, or abuse of drugs or alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report gross misconduct committed by another board licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly failing to report to the board any act of gross misconduct committed by another licensee of the board or failing to comply with any reporting requirement set forth in 30-3-14(b) of this code.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis or treatment of, or operation or prescription for, any human disease, pain, injury, deformity or other physical or mental condition
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine and surgery" means the diagnosis or treatment of, or operation or prescription for, any human disease, pain, injury, deformity or other physical or mental condition. "Surgery" includes the use on humans of lasers, ionizing radiation, pulsed light and radiofrequency devices.

value: surgery (including lasers, ionizing radiation, pulsed light, radiofrequency devices)
methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or treatment of, or operation or prescription for, any human disease, pain, injury, deformity or other physical or mental condition. "Surgery" includes the use on humans of lasers, ionizing radiation, pulsed light and radiofrequency devices.

drug_authority.value: Full prescriptive authority including controlled substances; telemedicine-only encounters may not prescribe Schedule II controlled substances except for established patients or specified exceptions
drug_authority.quote: A temporary license issued by the board authorizes the holder to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in West Virginia for the term of the temporary license, and includes full prescriptive authority.

license_status_types.quote: The board may renew, on an inactive basis, the license of a physician or podiatrist who is currently licensed to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in, but is not actually practicing, medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must hold a valid ECFMG certificate (or an unrestricted license in another state with 5 years of full-time practice and no pending discipline), complete a minimum of two years of ACGME-approved graduate clinical training, pass all USMLE components within 10 consecutive years, and demonstrate English language proficiency.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Holds a valid ECFMG certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has successfully completed: (i) A minimum of one year of graduate clinical training in a program is approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

pain_management_education_required.quote: shall complete drug diversion training, best-practice prescribing of controlled substances training, and training on prescribing and administering an opioid antagonist if that person prescribes, administers, or dispenses a controlled substance
pain_management_education_required.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 1. General Provisions Applicable to All State Boards

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: A physician practicing solely via telemedicine may not prescribe Schedule II controlled substances to that patient (except established patients and certain enumerated exceptions). A physician may not prescribe pain-relieving Schedule II controlled substances for chronic nonmalignant pain solely based upon a telemedicine encounter (except established patients).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A physician or podiatrist who practices medicine to a patient solely through the utilization of telemedicine technologies may not prescribe to that patient any controlled substances listed in Schedule II of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telemedicine practice is authorized but subject to standards. Schedule II controlled substances may not be prescribed to patients seen solely via telemedicine except for established patients or members of the same group practice. Pain-relieving Schedule II substances may not be prescribed for chronic nonmalignant pain solely based on a telemedicine encounter (same exception). Treatment based solely on an online questionnaire does not constitute an acceptable standard of care.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician or podiatrist who practices medicine to a patient solely through the utilization of telemedicine technologies may not prescribe to that patient any controlled substances listed in Schedule II of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act: Provided, That the prescribing limitations contained in this section do not apply to a physician or a member of the same group practice with an established patient.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: "Registration" means an authorization to practice a health profession regulated by 30-1-1 et seq. of this code for the limited purpose of providing interstate telehealth services within the registrants scope of practice.
telemedicine_license_available.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 1. General Provisions Applicable to All State Boards

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every person, partnership, corporation, association, insurance company, professional society, or other organization providing professional liability insurance to a physician or podiatrist in this state... shall submit to the board the following information within 30 days from any judgment or settlement of a civil or medical professional liability action

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The chief executive officer of every hospital shall, within 60 days after the completion of the hospitals formal disciplinary procedure... report in writing to the board the name of any member of the medical staff or any other physician or podiatrist practicing in the hospital whose hospital privileges have been revoked, restricted, reduced, or terminated for any cause

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: a physician, podiatrist or physician assistant licensed, certified or otherwise lawfully practicing in this state or applying for a license to practice in this state may enter into a voluntary agreement with the physician health program

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board under any circumstances may require a physician or podiatrist or person applying for licensure or other authorization to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state to submit to a physical or mental examination by a physician or physicians approved by the board.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board may issue an administrative medicine license to a physician who: (1) Files a complete application; (2) Pays the applicable fee; (3) Meets all qualifications and criteria for licensure set forth in 30-3-10 of this code and the boards legislative rules; and (4) Demonstrates competency to practice administrative medicine.
